# aemetools

aemetools is designed to work with
[AEME](https://github.com/limnotrack/AEME/). It contains a range of
functions to assist in setting up simulations for a lake site.

## Development

This package was developed by [LimnoTrack](http://limnotrack.com/) as
part of the [Lake Ecosystem Research New Zealand Modelling
Platform](https://limnotrack.shinyapps.io/LERNZmp/) (LERNZmp) project.
[![LimnoTrack
website](reference/figures/limnotrack_border.jpg)](http://limnotrack.com/)

## Overview

Currently, this package can be used to:

- Download meteorological data from
  [ERA5-Land](https://www.ecmwf.int/en/era5-land) for any point in New
  Zealand from 1980-2023, or download ERA5-Land GRIB files for any area
  in the world.
- Set up and run hydrological simulations using the suite of models from
  the [`airGR`](https://hydrogr.github.io/airGR/) package using
  catchment, reach and lake data.
- Conduct a sensitivity analysis on the parameters for the AEME models.
- Calibrate the AEME models using lake observational data.

## Installation

You can install the development version of aemetools from
[GitHub](https://github.com/) with:

``` r
# install.packages("devtools")
devtools::install_github("limnotrack/aemetools")
```

``` r
library(aemetools)
```

### Download NZ point meteorological data

Currently, there is ERA5-Land data (~9km grid spacing) archived for New
Zealand (166.5/-46.6/178.6/-34.5) for the time period 1980-2023 with the
main meteorological variables (air temperature, dewpoint temperature,
wind u-vector at 10m, wind v-vector at 10m, total precipitation,
snowfall, surface level pressure, downwelling shortwave radiation,
downwelling longwave radiation) required to drive hydrological and
hydrodynamic models. This can be easily downloaded using the example
below. There is a `parallel` switch which allows you to use multiple
cores on your computer to speed up the download.

``` r

lon <- 176.2717
lat <- -38.079
vars <- c("MET_tmpair", "MET_pprain")

met <- get_era5_land_point_nz(lat = lat, lon = lon, years = 2020:2021,
                      vars = vars)
summary(met)
#>       Date              MET_tmpair       MET_pprain      
#>  Min.   :2020-01-01   Min.   : 4.848   Min.   : 0.00000  
#>  1st Qu.:2020-07-01   1st Qu.: 9.699   1st Qu.: 0.08205  
#>  Median :2020-12-31   Median :12.729   Median : 0.83960  
#>  Mean   :2020-12-31   Mean   :12.845   Mean   : 5.10542  
#>  3rd Qu.:2021-07-01   3rd Qu.:15.782   3rd Qu.: 5.73165  
#>  Max.   :2021-12-31   Max.   :22.176   Max.   :53.44960
```

``` r

library(ggplot2)
library(tidyr)

met |> 
  pivot_longer(cols = c(MET_tmpair, MET_pprain)) |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = Date, y = value)) +
  geom_line() +
  facet_wrap(~name, scales = "free_y", ncol = 1) +
  theme_bw()
```

![](reference/figures/README-plot-era5-1.png)

# Package index

## All functions

- [`add_linz_key()`](add_linz_key.md) : Add LINZ API key to environment
  variables
- [`api_request()`](api_request.md) : Request data from the LERNZMP API
- [`calib_aeme()`](calib_aeme.md) : Calibrate AEME model parameters
  using observations
- [`calib_GR()`](calib_GR.md) : Calibrate GR model
- [`check_api_status()`](check_api_status.md) : Check API status
- [`convert_era5_ncdf()`](convert_era5_ncdf.md) : Convert ERA5 netCDF
  files to AEME or LER
- [`create_control()`](create_control.md) : Create control list for
  calibration or sensitivity analysis
- [`create_linz_key()`](create_linz_key.md) : Create LINZ API key
- [`create_param_var_matrix()`](create_param_var_matrix.md) : Create a
  parameter-variable matrix for each model
- [`decode_param()`](decode_param.md) : Decode a full parameter name to
  extract the base name.
- [`decode_param_full()`](decode_param_full.md) : Decode a full
  parameter name into group, name, and index.
- [`display_param_name()`](display_param_name.md) : Display parameter
  information in a human-readable format.
- [`download_era5_grib()`](download_era5_grib.md) : Download ERA5 GRIB
  files
- [`edit_param_var_matrix()`](edit_param_var_matrix.md) : Edit
  parameter–response matrix in a Shiny gadget
- [`encode_param()`](encode_param.md) : Encode a parameter name with its
  group and index.
- [`era5_ref_table`](era5_ref_table.md) : ERA5 reference table
- [`get_aeme()`](get_aeme.md) : Get Aeme object from LimnoTrack API
- [`get_catchment_data()`](get_catchment_data.md) : Get Catchment Data
- [`get_dem_raster()`](get_dem_raster.md) : Get DEM raster from LINZ
- [`get_dem_value()`](get_dem_value.md) : Get DEM value for a given
  latitude and longitude
- [`get_era5_isimip_point()`](get_era5_isimip_point.md) : Get ERA5 data
  from ISIMIP3a for a point location
- [`get_era5_land_point_nz()`](get_era5_land_point_nz.md) : Get ERA5
  data for a coordinate
- [`get_lake_shape()`](get_lake_shape.md) : Get lake shape as sf object
- [`get_layer_ids()`](get_layer_ids.md) : Get layer IDs for a given
  spatial object
- [`get_linz_basemap_tile()`](get_linz_basemap_tile.md) : Get LINZ
  basemap tile
- [`get_param()`](get_param.md) : Get parameter values from calibration
  results
- [`get_pareto_front()`](get_pareto_front.md) : Get the Pareto front
  from a data frame based on specified objective columns.
- [`get_raster_layer_value()`](get_raster_layer_value.md) : Get raster
  layer value for a given latitude and longitude
- [`get_raster_tile()`](get_raster_tile.md) : Get a raster tile from
  LINZ
- [`get_simulation_time()`](get_simulation_time.md) : Get simulation
  time for each model
- [`get_upstream_rec()`](get_upstream_rec.md) : Get all upstream reaches
- [`get_wlevel()`](get_wlevel.md) : Get modelled water level
- [`make_GR_inputs()`](make_GR_inputs.md) : Make inputs for the GR
  models
- [`nz_aerial_imagery_metadata`](nz_aerial_imagery_metadata.md) : sf
  object of aerial imagery metadata for New Zealand.
- [`nz_dem_metadata`](nz_dem_metadata.md) : sf object of Digital
  Elevation Model (DEM) metadata for New Zealand.
- [`param_var_matrix`](param_var_matrix.md) : AEME parameters-response
  matrix
- [`plot_calib()`](plot_calib.md) : Plot calibration results
- [`plot_calib_summary()`](plot_calib_summary.md) : Plot calibration
  results
- [`plot_ensemble()`](plot_ensemble.md) : Plot AEME ensemble output
- [`plot_multiscatter()`](plot_multiscatter.md) : Plot multiscatter of
  the parameters against each other
- [`plot_scatter()`](plot_scatter.md) : Plot the scatter of the output
  of a sensitivity analysis
- [`plot_sobol()`](plot_sobol.md) : Visualization of first, total,
  second, third and fourth-order Sobol' indices
- [`plot_uncertainty()`](plot_uncertainty.md) : Plot the uncertainty of
  the output of a sensitivity analysis
- [`query_elev()`](query_elev.md) : Query elevation data for a shape
  within a DEM raster
- [`read_calib_meta()`](read_calib_meta.md) : Read the calibration
  metadata
- [`read_grib_point()`](read_grib_point.md) : Read a point from a grib
  file
- [`read_sa()`](read_sa.md) : Read sensitivity analysis output
- [`read_simulation_meta()`](read_simulation_meta.md) : Read the
  simulation metadata
- [`read_simulation_output()`](read_simulation_output.md)
  [`read_calib()`](read_simulation_output.md) : Read calibration output
- [`read_web_sf()`](read_web_sf.md) : Read spatial feature (sf) data
  from online databases as sf object
- [`read_web_table()`](read_web_table.md) : Read table data from online
  databases as sf object
- [`run_aeme_ensemble()`](run_aeme_ensemble.md) : Run AEME ensemble
- [`run_aeme_param()`](run_aeme_param.md) : Run AEME with parameter
  dataframe
- [`run_aeme_shiny()`](run_aeme_shiny.md) : Run AEME in a Shiny app
- [`run_and_fit()`](run_and_fit.md) : Run a model and calculate model
  fit.
- [`run_GR()`](run_GR.md) : Run GR model
- [`sa_aeme()`](sa_aeme.md) : Run sensitivity analysis on AEME model
  parameters
- [`set_weights()`](set_weights.md) : Set weights for simulated
  variables
- [`update_param()`](update_param.md) : Update parameter values in param
  based on best_pars
- [`write_csv_to_db()`](write_csv_to_db.md) : Write
  calibration/sensitivity analysis .csv files to database
